alsoWorthNoting.description: The inspection took place at the branch factory of Dongguan Jiahong Toy Co., Ltd., located in Jingfenghuang Industrial Zone, Fenggan Town, Dongguan City, approximately 10 km away with a 20-minute travel time.
No approval sample was present at the factory during inspection. The factory will send 4 sealed production samples to the client, but no waybill was provided.
Raw materials: Ball, electric parts, and all packaging materials (instruction sheet, label, gift box, cartons) were 100% completed.
The ball will be painted, assembled with electric parts, and then packed into the gift box and master carton.
Function test: Turn-off time was approximately 41-44 seconds.
Each battery voltage measured 1.48–1.49 volts instead of the specified 3 volts.

recommendedActions.actionTitle: Schedule an Initial Production Check on your next production
recommendedActions.actionContent: Product with dimension out of tolerances cannot be easily reworked once finished. Initial Production Check (IPC) may help to identify point of tolerances at early stage of the production and improve with the factory for the remaining balances.

workmanshipAql.description: Key defects found: 2 Minor Poor printing, 1 Major Poor printing and 1 Minor Stain / streaks.
workmanshipAql.itemContent: Key defects found: 2 Minor Poor printing, 1 Major Poor printing and 1 Minor Stain / streaks.

recommendedActions.actionContent: Utilize high-quality printing methods that offer strong adhesion to the material surface, such as UV curing, heat transfer, or screen printing. Choose printing techniques based on the material type and intended product use to ensure maximum durability.
